title: pr_doctor_fix — the PR doctor's fix report (more-local-inference 06)
description: The doctor's one fix turn. fix_gate checks the Input receipt, then publish posts this verbatim in the marker comment so the human who takes the PR sees what was tried. `reviewable` is the doctor's own judgement of whether one more hosted review could pass: false when a remaining blocker is one only .fabro/ci.sh could prove, or one no code change can satisfy (a PR description, a label, a risk rating). _io is stamped by the server and is not part of this schema.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the report said was wrong, and what you changed. Published verbatim.

commands.description: Every command the report named that you ran yourself, with its result. Empty when the report named none. `output` is the last lines of what it printed.

reviewable.description: false when a follow-up review cannot pass whatever this run does: a blocker is provable only by .fabro/ci.sh, or no code change can satisfy it. Then the run is handed off without a hosted review.

blockers.description: What stops a follow-up review from passing, one entry each. Must be non-empty when reviewable is false; may be empty when it is true.

kind.description: command_only: only .fabro/ci.sh can prove it, and this run may not edit .fabro/*. not_code: no code change can satisfy it (a PR description, a label, a risk rating, a review conversation).
